items.subject: The Colonial mine tailings dump spreading down a red-earth slope, its blue asbestos tailings cut by fresh runoff
items.action: Rainwater runoff carries tailings off the dump, threading pale blue silt down eroded gullies toward the plain
items.gaze_interaction: No human; the eye follows the runoff downslope from the dump into the valley
items.setting: Hamersley Range foothills below the abandoned Colonial mine, Banjima country, Western Australia, present day
items.color_palette: Red earth, ochre, dusty grey-brown, threads of muted asbestos blue, pale dawn sky
items.props_detail: A shallow braided rivulet of muddy water leaving the foot of the dump
items.lens_technique: Deep depth of field, wide-angle aerial perspective
items.lighting: Soft dawn light, low raking sun after rain, long shadows in the gullies
items.mood: Stillness; wet sheen on red slopes, mist lifting, water moving silently away from the dump
items.narration_anchor: Los relaves del vertedero de Colonial se van con el agua.

items.subject: Deep erosion gullies leading from the tailings dump into a dry creek, marked as the asbestos pathway
items.action: Erosion channels cut from the dump edge and merge into the creek line, carrying grey-blue sediment
items.gaze_interaction: No human; focal line runs from a weathered survey stake down the gully into the creek
items.setting: Gully head below the Colonial tailings dump, spinifex and scattered white-barked gums, Wittenoom area
items.color_palette: Ochre, rust red, grey sediment, faint blue streaks, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: A weathered timber survey stake with tattered faded flagging tape at the gully lip
items.camera_angle: High angle looking down the gully line
items.lighting: Soft dawn light, low raking sun picking out the gully edges
items.mood: Quiet morning, damp earth slumped into channels, nothing moving but drying water
items.narration_anchor: Un informe técnico lo marcó como la fuente principal y la vía del asbesto:

items.subject: A network of creek beds, rock pools and floodplains stretching toward the Fortescue River
items.action: Sediment-laden water lies in pools and spreads thinly across the floodplain toward the distant river
items.gaze_interaction: No human; the eye travels from foreground pools across the floodplain to the river line on the horizon
items.setting: Fortescue River catchment below Wittenoom Gorge, Banjima country, Pilbara, present day
items.color_palette: Red earth, ochre banks, olive spinifex, silver water, pale dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: A still rock pool reflecting the sky, its rim edged with grey-blue silt
items.lens_technique: Deep depth of field, wide aerial lens
items.lighting: Soft dawn light, low sun glinting off scattered pools
items.mood: Vast silence, mist over the floodplain, water lying motionless across the land
items.narration_anchor: la erosión, los lechos de arroyo, las pozas, las llanuras de inundación hacia el río Fortescue.

items.subject: Blue asbestos fibres stranded at the dried edge of a creek pool
items.action: As the pool recedes, the water leaves the fibres behind on the cracking mud
items.gaze_interaction: No human; focus on the line where wet mud turns to dry crust
items.setting: Margin of a drying rock pool in a creek bed, Wittenoom catchment
items.color_palette: Cracked red mud, ochre crust, muted asbestos blue, wet dark rust
items.props_detail: A thin curling crust of dried mud lifting at the pool's edge
items.lens_technique: Shallow depth of field, macro-style 100mm lens
items.lighting: Soft dawn light, low raking sun skimming the dried crust
items.mood: Stillness; evaporating water, a faint shimmer of drying moisture, no movement
items.narration_anchor: Fibras azules que el agua deja donde se seca.

items.subject: A creek channel running past a faded contamination boundary post into open country
items.action: The channel carries faint blue-grey deposits past the boundary and on beyond it
items.gaze_interaction: No human; the eye follows the streaked channel from the post into the distance
items.setting: Creek channel at the edge of the Wittenoom contaminated zone, spinifex flats, 2021
items.color_palette: Red earth, ochre banks, grey silt, faint blue streaks, bleached timber
items.props_detail: A sun-bleached leaning boundary post with peeling paint beside the creek bank
items.lighting: Soft dawn light, low raking sun along the channel
items.mood: Quiet; the channel winding on unhindered, empty land on both sides of the post
items.narration_anchor: En dos mil veintiuno, una nota ambiental registró fibras en canales de arroyos fuera de la zona marcada como contaminada.

items.subject: The Fortescue River catchment receiving creek inflow from the Wittenoom side
items.action: Sediment-tinted creek water slowly feeds into the broad river channel
items.gaze_interaction: No human; focal point where the tinted creek meets the clearer river water
items.setting: Confluence of a Wittenoom creek with the Fortescue River, Pilbara plains to the horizon
items.color_palette: Red earth, olive river gums, silver-green water, faint grey-blue plume, pale dawn sky
items.props_detail: A slow pale plume of silt fanning into the river current
items.lens_technique: Deep depth of field, wide aerial lens
items.lighting: Soft dawn light, low sun haze over the water
items.mood: Calm, endless; the flow continuing quietly toward a far horizon
items.narration_anchor: El mismo informe advirtió que, sin intervención, el aporte de asbesto a la cuenca del Fortescue puede seguir durante cientos de años.

items.subject: An elderly Aboriginal Australian Banjima man around 70, thin and gaunt, seated with a middle-aged Latin American visiting official
items.action: The two sit together on low camp chairs beside a dry creek, the elder speaking, the visitor listening
items.gaze_interaction: Elder looks out over the creek bed; the visitor leans toward him, both seen at a distance
items.setting: Shade of a white-barked ghost gum beside a dry creek bed on Banjima country, 2023
items.color_palette: Red earth, ochre, white gum bark, sun-faded khaki and cotton shirts, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: The elder's sweat-stained wide-brimmed felt hat resting on his knee
items.lighting: Warm late-afternoon golden light filtering through gum leaves
items.mood: Unhurried stillness, long shadows, the elder's slow careful posture
items.narration_anchor: Es tierra Banjima. En dos mil veintitrés, Marcos Orellana visitó Australia y se sentó con Maitland Parker, un anciano Banjima.

items.subject: An elderly Aboriginal Australian Banjima man around 70, thin frame, sunken cheeks, weathered lined face, sun-faded long-sleeve work shirt
items.action: He stands alone on the creek bank, hat held at his chest, unable to turn away from his country
items.gaze_interaction: Face toward the camera in three-quarter, eyes lowered to the creek bed, shoulders drawn and stooped
items.setting: Red-earth bank above a dry creek on Banjima country, gorge walls behind, 2023
items.color_palette: Red earth, ochre cliffs, faded khaki, dusty blue sky turning gold
items.props_detail: A sweat-stained wide-brimmed felt hat held against his chest
items.lighting: Warm late-afternoon golden light, rim light on his shoulders
items.mood: Stillness; a slight stoop, slow breath, wind lifting dust along the bank behind him
items.narration_anchor: «Todavía lloro por mi territorio, pero eso está arraigado en mí; simplemente no puedo alejarme de él», dijo Parker.

items.subject: An empty camp chair and a wide-brimmed felt hat left beneath a ghost gum by the dry creek
items.action: The chair stands unoccupied as dusk settles over the creek bed
items.gaze_interaction: No human; focal point on the hat resting on the empty seat
items.setting: The same gum-shaded creek bank on Banjima country, 2024
items.color_palette: Dusky red earth, deep ochre, white gum bark, fading violet sky
items.props_detail: A sweat-stained felt hat resting on the canvas seat
items.lighting: Last golden light at dusk, long shadow of the empty chair
items.mood: Silence after; long shadow, still air, a few leaves settled on the seat
items.narration_anchor: Maitland Parker murió de mesotelioma en dos mil veinticuatro.

items.subject: A small group of Aboriginal Australian Banjima community members, mixed ages, plain cotton shirts and dresses, seen from behind
items.action: They climb the broad steps of the Federal Court building to lodge the case
items.gaze_interaction: Figures read by form from behind, heads raised toward the entrance
items.setting: Exterior of a stone Federal Court building in a Western Australian city, 2026
items.color_palette: Grey stone, muted sandstone, faded ochre and khaki clothing, pale overcast sky
items.props_detail: A worn cardboard archive box carried under one man's arm
items.camera_angle: Low angle from the foot of the steps
items.mood: Measured steady climb, small figures against a large stone facade
items.narration_anchor: Dos años después, Gordon Legal presentó en nombre de BNTAC un proceso contra Australia Occidental en el Tribunal Federal.

items.subject: A permanent steel-and-earth barricade cutting the road into the old town and the gorge
items.action: Wind drives red dust across the empty road beyond the barricade
items.gaze_interaction: No human; the eye passes over the barricade to the empty red land beyond
items.setting: Road entrance to the abandoned Wittenoom townsite and gorge, Pilbara, 2024
items.color_palette: Red earth, ochre, rusted steel, faded white paint, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: A rust-streaked closure sign bolted to the barricade
items.lighting: Low windswept late-afternoon light, dust haze
items.mood: Emptiness; dust drifting over a deserted road, nothing beyond but wind and red earth
items.narration_anchor: Nadie ha empezado a limpiar. En los accesos al pueblo y desfiladero hay bloqueos.

items.subject: The abandoned Wittenoom townsite seen from above, sealed off behind its barricaded access road
items.action: Wind carries red dust across the deserted street grid and empty lots
items.gaze_interaction: No human; the eye moves from the blocked road into the silent townsite and gorge mouth
items.setting: Wittenoom ghost town and gorge entrance, Hamersley Range, 2024
items.color_palette: Red earth, ochre, grey weathered corrugated iron, faint blue tailings, dusky sky
items.props_detail: The barricaded road running into the empty grid
items.lens_technique: Deep depth of field, wide aerial lens
items.lighting: Windswept dusk light, low sun through dust haze
items.mood: Suspended silence; drifting dust, long shadows, no movement in the town
items.narration_anchor: El gobierno de Australia Occidental habla de un «grave problema de salud y seguri
